例句

  1. If you expect that schools only teach academic subjects, then this proves that you don’t understand what schools are for.
    如果你以為學校只教學科，那就證明你不懂學校是做什麼用的。
  2. If you are tired, then you should go to bed early.
    如果你累了，那就應該早點睡。
  3. If it snows tomorrow, then we will build a snowman.
    如果明天下雪，那我們就來堆雪人。
  4. If you want to pass the test, then you have to study every day.
    如果你想通過考試，那你就必須每天讀書。
  5. If the store is closed, then we can go to the one near the station.
    如果那家店關了，那我們可以去車站附近的那家。
  6. If you don't like fish, then don't order the sushi set.
    如果你不喜歡魚，那就不要點壽司套餐。
  7. If he says that, then he is wrong.
    如果他那樣說，那他就錯了。
  8. I don't know where this bus goes.
    我不知道這班公車開往哪裡。
  9. Do you know what this button is for?
    你知道這個按鈕是做什麼用的嗎？
  10. Can you tell me where the nearest bank is?
    你可以告訴我最近的銀行在哪裡嗎？
  11. I wonder what time the museum opens.
    不知道博物館幾點開門。
  12. Nobody knows why Tom left the club.
    沒有人知道 Tom 為什麼退出社團。
  13. Do you know what this money is for?
    你知道這筆錢是要做什麼用的嗎？
  14. I asked my teacher what the word meant.
    我問老師那個字是什麼意思。
  15. Please tell me who that man is.
    請告訴我那個男人是誰。
  16. The photo proves that he was there.
    這張照片證明他當時在那裡。
  17. I expect that the test will be easy.
    我想考試應該會很簡單。
  18. The test results prove that you studied hard.
    考試成績證明你很用功。
  19. The video proved that the ball was out.
    影片證明那顆球出界了。
  20. We expect that more tourists will come to Taiwan next year.
    我們預期明年會有更多觀光客來台灣。
  21. Nobody expected that the game would end so soon.
    沒有人想到比賽會那麼快結束。
  22. If you expect that everything will be easy, then you will be disappointed.
    如果你以為每件事都會很簡單，那你會失望的。
  23. If he can't answer this question, then it proves that he didn't read the book.
    如果他答不出這個問題，那就證明他沒有讀那本書。
  24. Students should understand what tests are for.
    學生應該了解考試是做什麼用的。
  25. I finally understood what the meeting was for.
    我終於了解那場會議的目的是什麼。
  26. This letter proves that my grandfather lived in Tokyo.
    這封信證明我爺爺曾經住在東京。
  27. Did you expect that Ann would win?
    你有想到 Ann 會贏嗎？
  28. If you know what this tool is for, then please tell me.
    如果你知道這個工具是做什麼用的，那就請告訴我。
  29. I can't remember where I put my key.
    我想不起來我把鑰匙放在哪裡。
  30. If it is sunny on Sunday, then let's go to the beach.
    如果星期天天氣晴朗，那我們就去海邊吧。
